method: Complete pinned Spanish catalog read, Git/SHA256 verification; parsed active entries and ran msgfmt normal checks plus explicit use-fuzzy diagnostic into private outputs.
findings: 264 active entries,172 nonempty,47 fuzzy,125 nonfuzzy nonempty. Obsolete historical entries are not counted as active coverage.
Normal msgfmt --check --check-format exits0 with four placeholder-header warnings. This is not complete or semantically verified Spanish UI.
Explicit --use-fuzzy diagnostic exits1 with12 fatal format/newline errors. Default build does not request use-fuzzy, so these are pending-translation issues, not proof of active-format crash.
Fuzzy read error changes long-long format to long; regex count changes unsigned to signed; several parser errors lose argument placeholders. Clearing fuzzy indiscriminately would fail validation.

Fuzzy Cross mountpoints translates opposite no-cross meaning; Not linked has unrelated other-lint text, and GUI find/clean label borrows hidden-directory text. These entries remain excluded by normal compiler.

Active early-shutdown/interruption/read-directory and changed-mtime messages are translated, while many newer reflink uncertainty/error states and GUI settings remain blank. Completeness must be assessed by message identity, not byte/file size.
Header Language and translator/revision metadata retain template defaults. Modern POT date alone does not establish maintained translations.
